# Theraglee

> Theraglee (theraglee.com) is a US mental health site with free, plain-language articles, free interactive self-discovery tools, daily challenges, checklists and a journal, plus a directory of therapists whose state licenses Theraglee has verified. Theraglee Match Mode lets a member opt in to being contacted by matching therapists while staying pseudonymous. Theraglee does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment, and nothing on it screens for or diagnoses any condition. In a crisis in the US, call or text 988.

Facts worth getting right: every article is free to read with no account; the 360 self-discovery tools are free with no account; a free member account (no card) adds the journal, checklists, challenges and Match Mode; quizzes and worksheets are part of the paid Basic membership; therapists pay one flat listing rate with no per-session fees; member information is never sold, used for advertising, or used to train AI.

## Start here
- [Homepage](https://theraglee.com/): what Theraglee is, free tools, the directory
- [Find a therapist](https://theraglee.com/therapists.html): license-verified directory, free to browse
- [Theraglee Match Mode](https://theraglee.com/match-mode.html): how the right therapist finds you
- [For therapists](https://theraglee.com/for-therapists.html): one flat rate, no per-session fees
- [Membership plans](https://theraglee.com/pricing.html): Free, Basic and Premium
- [Privacy promise](https://theraglee.com/privacy-promise.html): never sold, never advertised, never trained on
- [How to find a therapist](https://theraglee.com/articles/how-to-find-a-therapist): a plain guide

## Hand-written guides and tool pages
- [Anxiety quiz: a five-minute check-in on how anxiety shows up for you](https://theraglee.com/tools/anxiety-quiz): A short anxiety check-in you can take in about five minutes. Not a diagnosis, just a structured way to notice where anxiety shows up for you, with free reading and next steps.
- [Depression quiz: a low-mood check-in, not a diagnosis](https://theraglee.com/tools/depression-quiz): A short low-mood check-in, written in plain language. It is not a depression screener and it does not diagnose. Use it to notice patterns, then decide whether to talk to someone.
- [CBT thought record worksheet](https://theraglee.com/tools/cbt-thought-record): A printable CBT thought record worksheet, plus a plain-English walkthrough of each column and a worked example. Catch the thought, check the evidence, write a fairer version.
- [12 journal prompts for burnout](https://theraglee.com/tools/journal-prompts-burnout): Twelve journal prompts for burnout, written for the flat and depleted kind of week rather than the busy kind. Free to read, with a burnout check-in and related worksheets.
- [How to find a therapist](https://theraglee.com/articles/how-to-find-a-therapist): What the license letters mean, how much therapy costs, where to look, what to ask on a first call, and what to do when nobody has openings. A practical US guide.
- [Journal prompts](https://theraglee.com/tools/journal-prompts): the prompts members get one a day
- [Quizzes](https://theraglee.com/tools/quizzes): 312 short check-ins by topic (Basic membership)
- [Worksheets](https://theraglee.com/tools/worksheets): 186 fillable worksheets by topic (Basic membership)
